alignment: NONE: detector error measured in the original image coordinate system

evaluation.failure_policy: every failed attempt stays in case/PCK/AUC denominators; NME conditional on complete cases is labeled
evaluation.reference_limit: errors are relative to recorded annotations; blinding is declared, not independently attested
evaluation.covariance_limit: perturbation repeatability is not localization accuracy
evaluation.rater_agreement_limit: disagreement needs at least two raters; zero with one rater is not evidence of agreement

independence: curator-supplied group/lineage IDs; no identity inference
